reference_prolog:
% Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
% Jurisdiction: South Carolina
% Focus year: 2021

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Statute translation: SC Code  27-37-160 (2021)
% Topic: Who executes a writ of ejectment/eviction and what duties they have.
%
% Key legal point used for this question:
% The statute specifies that execution is performed by "the constable or deputy sheriff".
% No other entities are named as empowered executors.
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

% statute_sc_27_37_160_executor_role(Role).
% SC Code  27-37-160 (2021): "the constable or deputy sheriff shall proceed..."
statute_sc_27_37_160_executor_role(constable).
statute_sc_27_37_160_executor_role(deputy_sheriff).

% legal_entity_empowered_to_execute_writ(State, Year, Entity).
% Deterministic gateway for empowerment under the translated statute.
legal_entity_empowered_to_execute_writ(south_carolina, 2021, Entity) :-
    entity_role(Entity, Role),
    statute_sc_27_37_160_executor_role(Role),
    !.
legal_entity_empowered_to_execute_writ(_State, _Year, _Entity) :-
    fail.

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Scenario translation (facts)
% Question: "Is a private company an entity empowered by law to execute a writ of eviction?"
% We encode a scenario with an entity that is a private company and ask whether it is empowered.
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

% scenario metadata
scenario_state(south_carolina).
scenario_year(2021).

% The entity at issue
scenario_entity(private_company_acme).

% Fact: private_company_acme is a private company.
entity_type(private_company_acme, private_company).

% For this scenario, the private company does NOT have the statutory roles.
% (We encode what the scenario says: it is a private company; no constable/deputy_sheriff role.)
entity_role(private_company_acme, private_company_agent).

% scenario_statement/0 succeeds when the scenario is set up as described.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(south_carolina),
    scenario_year(2021),
    scenario_entity(E),
    entity_type(E, private_company),
    entity_role(E, private_company_agent).

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Reasoning for the question asked
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

% scenario_entity_empowered/0: whether the scenario entity is empowered by law to execute the writ.
scenario_entity_empowered :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_year(Year),
    scenario_entity(E),
    legal_entity_empowered_to_execute_writ(State, Year, E).

% housing_answer(Result) where Result is yes or no (deterministic).
housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_entity_empowered,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Main entrypoint (required)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is a private company an entity empowered by law to execute a writ of eviction?
